en.title: DR Congo Ebola outbreak exceeds 11,000 cases
en.dek: DR Congo authorities announced Wednesday the outbreak has surpassed 11,000 total cases, with 5,387 deaths, as Kenya discharged its last patient and began a 42-day countdown to Ebola-free status.
facts: Total cases in DR Congo have surpassed 11,000.
Death toll in DR Congo stands at 5,387.
Kenya discharged its last Ebola patient on Wednesday.
Kenya began a 42-day countdown to being declared Ebola-free.
Health officials report difficulties containing the virus spread.
International organizations are monitoring the situation.
body: DR Congo authorities announced Wednesday that the Ebola outbreak has surpassed 11,000 total cases, with 5,387 deaths, according to the Ministry of Health and Al Jazeera.
Al Jazeera reported that these figures represent the highest number of cases recorded in the country's history for this virus, as stated by government officials.
MedicalXpress reported that health officials are facing significant difficulties in containing the spread of the virus as teams work in affected regions.
Kenya discharged its last Ebola patient on Wednesday, Health Minister Aden Duale said, as reported by BBC and The Straits Times.
The country began a 42-day countdown to being declared Ebola-free, provided no new cases are recorded, according to BBC and The Straits Times.
BBC reported that this marks a major milestone towards virus-free status in the region.
Health workers are currently attempting to track transmission chains to limit further infections across affected areas.
International health organizations are monitoring the situation as case numbers rise and response efforts continue.
The government has requested additional resources to manage the medical response as the outbreak evolves.
en.context: Ebola outbreaks in the Democratic Republic of the Congo have occurred periodically since the virus was first identified in 1976. The current event is classified by health authorities as the deadliest outbreak of the virus in the nation's history. The virus spreads through contact with bodily fluids and causes severe symptoms including fever, bleeding, and organ failure.

en.dek: Democratic Republic of the Congo health authorities report that the ongoing Ebola outbreak has reached 11,000 total cases.
body: Democratic Republic of the Congo authorities announced on 11 November that the Ebola outbreak has reached 11,000 total cases. This figure represents the highest number of cases recorded in the country's history for this virus.
The Ministry of Health stated that 5,387 people have died from the disease. Al Jazeera reported that these numbers reflect the current scale of the health crisis.

Government officials said they are facing significant difficulties in containing the spread of the virus. MedicalXpress reported that these challenges persist as health teams work in affected regions.
The outbreak continues to impact local communities across the country. Health workers are currently attempting to track transmission chains to limit further infections.
International health organizations are monitoring the situation as case numbers rise. The government has requested additional resources to manage the medical response.
Ebola is a viral hemorrhagic fever that spreads through contact with bodily fluids. The virus causes severe symptoms including fever, bleeding, and organ failure.
facts: Health officials announced the figures on Wednesday.
Authorities report difficulties in containing the virus spread.

de.dek: Die Gesundheitsbehörden der Demokratischen Republik Kongo melden, dass der anhaltende Ebola-Ausbruch insgesamt 11.000 Fälle erreicht hat.
body: Die Behörden der Demokratischen Republik Kongo gaben am 11. November bekannt, dass der Ebola-Ausbruch insgesamt 11.000 Fälle erreicht hat. Diese Zahl stellt die höchste jemals im Land verzeichnete Fallzahl für dieses Virus dar.
Das Gesundheitsministerium erklärte, dass 5.387 Menschen an der Krankheit gestorben sind. Al Jazeera berichtete, dass diese Zahlen das aktuelle Ausmaß der Gesundheitskrise widerspiegeln.

Regierungsvertreter erklärten, sie stünden vor erheblichen Schwierigkeiten bei der Eindämmung der Virusausbreitung. MedicalXpress berichtete, dass diese Herausforderungen bestehen bleiben, während Gesundheitsteams in den betroffenen Regionen arbeiten.
Der Ausbruch beeinträchtigt weiterhin die lokalen Gemeinschaften im ganzen Land. Gesundheitspersonal versucht derzeit, Übertragungsketten nachzuverfolgen, um weitere Infektionen zu begrenzen.

Internationale Gesundheitsorganisationen beobachten die Situation angesichts der steigenden Fallzahlen. Die Regierung hat zusätzliche Ressourcen zur Bewältigung der medizinischen Reaktion angefordert.
Ebola ist ein virales hämorrhagisches Fieber, das durch Kontakt mit Körperflüssigkeiten übertragen wird. Das Virus verursacht schwere Symptome wie Fieber, Blutungen und Organversagen.
facts: Die Gesamtzahl der Fälle hat 11.000 überschritten.
Die Zahl der Todesopfer liegt bei 5.387.
Gesundheitsbeamte gaben die Zahlen am Mittwoch bekannt.
Die Behörden berichten von Schwierigkeiten bei der Eindämmung der Virusausbreitung.

en.headline: Kenya discharges last Ebola patient, starts 42-day countdown to Ebola-free status
en.body: Kenya discharged its last Ebola patient on Wednesday, Health Minister Aden Duale said. The country began a 42-day countdown to being declared Ebola-free, provided no new cases are recorded.

de.headline: Kenia entlässt letzten Ebola-Patienten und beginnt 42-tägigen Countdown zur Ebola-freien Status
de.body: Kenia entließ seinen letzten Ebola-Patienten am Mittwoch, sagte Gesundheitsminister Aden Duale. Das Land begann einen 42-tägigen Countdown zur Erklärung der Ebola-Freiheit, vorausgesetzt, es werden keine neuen Fälle registriert.

it.headline: Kenya dimette ultimo paziente Ebola, inizia il conto alla rovescia di 42 giorni per lo stato di assenza di Ebola
it.body: Il Kenya ha dimesso il suo ultimo paziente Ebola mercoledì, ha dichiarato il Ministro della Salute Aden Duale. Il Paese ha iniziato un conto alla rovescia di 42 giorni per essere dichiarato esente da Ebola, a condizione che non vengano registrati nuovi casi.

es.headline: Kenia da de alta a último paciente de Ébola e inicia cuenta atrás de 42 días hacia el estatus libre de Ébola
es.body: Kenia dio de alta a su último paciente de Ébola el miércoles, según declaró el Ministro de Sanidad, Aden Duale. El país ha comenzado una cuenta atrás de 42 días para ser declarado libre de Ébola, siempre que no se registren nuevos casos.

fr.headline: Le Kenya décharge son dernier patient Ebola et entame un compte à rebours de 42 jours vers le statut exempt d'Ebola
fr.body: Le Kenya a déchargé son dernier patient Ebola mercredi, a déclaré le ministre de la Santé, Aden Duale. Le pays a commencé un compte à rebours de 42 jours pour être déclaré exempt d'Ebola, à condition qu'aucun nouveau cas ne soit enregistré.

zh.headline: 肯尼亚出院最后一名埃博拉患者，开始42天倒计时迈向ปลอด埃博拉状态
zh.body: 卫生部长阿登·杜阿莱（Aden Duale）周三表示，肯尼亚已出院最后一名埃博拉患者。前提是没有新病例报告，该国已开始42天的倒计时，以宣布ปลอด埃博拉状态。

pt.headline: Quénia desliga último paciente de Ebola e inicia contagem decrescente de 42 dias para estatuto livre de Ebola
pt.body: O Ministro da Saúde, Aden Duale, afirmou que o Quénia descarregou o seu último paciente de Ebola na quarta-feira. O país iniciou uma contagem decrescente de 42 dias para ser declarado livre de Ebola, desde que não sejam registados novos casos.

ja.headline: ケニア、最後のエボラ患者を退院させ、エボラ陰性宣言までの42日間カウントダウン開始
ja.body: アデン・デュアレ保健大臣によると、ケニアは水曜日に最後のエボラ患者を退院させた。新たな症例が報告されなければ、同国はエボラ陰性として宣言されるまでの42日間のカウントダウンを開始した。

ko.headline: 케냐, 마지막 에볼라 환자 퇴원…42일 후 에볼라 프리 선언 카운트다운 돌입
ko.body: 케냐 보건부 장관 아데누 두알레에 따르면, 케냐가 수요일 마지막 에볼라 환자를 퇴원시켰다. 신규 환자가 기록되지 않는 한, 해당 국가는 에볼라 프리(무 에볼라) 선언을 앞두고 42일 간의 카운트다운에 들어갔다.
